source_note: 逐字原文以用户日志为准; 社区 Wiki 普通页面用于核对语境。日志未保留颜色码的消息不伪造 raw; 分段按语义边界保留运行时颜色。
note: 仅收录日志中的入口任务线; 名词按普通词规则译为独行冒险者、虚空之剑、末影护甲。八件合称末影套装。

messages.text: Exhausted? me? No no no.
messages.zh: 累了? 我? 不不不。

messages.text: I'm just taking a break.
messages.zh: 我只是在歇会儿。

messages.text: The End is a creepy place, but you get used to it!
messages.zh: 末地是有点瘆人,不过待久了就习惯了!
messages.raw: §5The End §ris a creepy place, but you get used to it!

segments.text: is a creepy place, but you get used to it!
segments.zh: 是有点瘆人,不过待久了就习惯了!

messages.context: 建议先击杀入口附近的末影人
messages.text: If you want a piece of advice, you should start by killing the Endermen up here.
messages.zh: 要我给点建议的话,你应该先练练手,去杀这上面的末影人。
messages.raw: If you want a piece of advice, you should start by killing the §cEndermen §rup here.

segments.text: If you want a piece of advice, you should start by killing the
segments.zh: 要我给点建议的话,你应该先练练手,去杀这上面的

messages.text: They sometimes drop important gear like the armor I'm wearing.
messages.zh: 它们有时会掉落很有用的装备,比如我身上这套护甲。
messages.raw: They sometimes drop important gear like the §aarmor §rI'm wearing.

segments.text: They sometimes drop important gear like the
segments.zh: 它们有时会掉落很有用的装备,比如我身上这套

messages.text: Are you strong enough though?
messages.zh: 不过,你的实力够吗?

messages.text: Try killing %s of them!

placeholders.desc: 要求击杀的末影人数量

messages.zh: 先试着击杀 %s 只吧!

messages.context: 完成击杀任务后推销虚空之剑
messages.text: Alright, not bad, not bad!
messages.zh: 行啊,不错不错!

messages.context: 完成击杀任务后推销虚空之剑
messages.text: It took me a while to get that strong.
messages.zh: 我当初可是练了好一阵才有这身手。
messages.raw: §fIt took me a while to get that strong.

messages.text: I use a Void Sword, it's a very powerful weapon.
messages.zh: 我用的是虚空之剑,这武器可厉害了。
messages.raw: I use a §5Void Sword§r, it's a very powerful weapon.

messages.context: 末影护甲件数提高虚空之剑的威力
messages.text: It gets stronger with each piece of Ender Armor you are wearing.
messages.zh: 你身上的末影护甲每多一件,它的威力就更强一分。
messages.raw: It gets stronger with each piece of §5Ender Armor §ryou are wearing.

segments.text: It gets stronger with each piece of

segments.zh: 每多一件,它的威力就更强一分。

messages.context: 夸张地表达不舍,为开价作铺垫
messages.text: I have an extremely strong emotional attachment to this item so...
messages.zh: 我对这把剑可是感情深厚,所以嘛……

messages.context: 推销虚空之剑; modest sum 是故作便宜的口吻
messages.text: I'm willing to sell it to you for the modest sum of %s coins.
messages.zh: 我愿意卖给你,只收你区区 %s 硬币。
messages.raw: I'm willing to sell it to you for the modest sum of §6%s coins§r.

segments.text: I'm willing to sell it to you for the modest sum of
segments.zh: 我愿意卖给你,只收你区区

messages.text: What do you say?
messages.zh: 你意下如何?

messages.context: 玩家拒绝购买后的挽留
messages.text: I think you are making a mistake, perhaps the biggest mistake of your life!
messages.zh: 我觉得你这决定可不明智,说不定会后悔一辈子!

messages.context: 再次确认是否拒绝购买
messages.text: Are you sure you don't want that sword?
messages.zh: 你确定不要这把剑?

messages.text: Happy dealing with you, I hope this sword will help you as much as it helped me.
messages.zh: 成交,合作愉快! 希望这把剑也能像当初帮我一样帮到你。

messages.context: 建议收齐八件末影护甲与装备
messages.text: You should focus on getting all %s pieces of the Ender Armor now.

placeholders.desc: 含四件护甲和四件装备的总件数

messages.gloss: 此处 Ender Armor 泛指八件末影套装,不能误写成八个护甲槽。
messages.zh: 接下来,你该专心收齐全套 %s 件末影套装了。
messages.raw: You should focus on getting all %s pieces of the §5Ender Armor §rnow.

segments.text: You should focus on getting all %s pieces of the
segments.zh: 接下来,你该专心收齐全套 %s 件

messages.context: 解释八件套装的获取方式
messages.text: Half of them are dropped by the Endermen on this layer, the other pieces are a little harder to obtain.
messages.zh: 其中一半会由这一层的末影人掉落,其余几件就没那么容易找了。

messages.text: I'm sure you'll figure it out.
messages.zh: 我相信你会找到办法的。

messages.text: My time here is over, I think I'll go down in the Dragon's Nest very soon.
messages.zh: 我在这儿待得差不多了,应该很快就会下到龙巢去。
messages.raw: My time here is over, I think I'll go down in the §5Dragon's Nest §rvery soon.

segments.zh: 我在这儿待得差不多了,应该很快就会下到

messages.text: See you around!
messages.zh: 回头见!
